row_format.state_at_receipt: raw CSV substring of the 20 state fields before generation
row_format.generated: raw CSV substrings of the 20 state fields for the 5 generated steps (t = 0.5 ... 2.5 s); empty value = field missing in LLM output
row_format.ack_log: full raw rx/tx JSON records from the ACK log; label_in_source added where the source block label differs from the case
row_format.column_mapping_note: field names inferred from row structure; verify against the CSV header
row_format.verification: all 460 generated rows, states at receipt, heartbeats and latencies checked programmatically against the raw CSV logs; ACK records copied from the raw ACK log by timestamp
